items.title: Arturo O'Farrill interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, May 6, 2024
items.q: he became, he was a protégé of Billy — of not Billy Taylor — Barry Harris.

ctx.x: Yeah. In fact nothing is more important than the groove. My kids, when they were growing up, I terrorized them ‘cause I would literally I would look at them out of the blue and I would say, “What’s more important than the groove?” And they’d look at me and go, “Uh nothing?” We had tee shirts made up during the pandemic — I don’t know if you know anything about this but I have a whole — like I started a nonprofit 17 years ago called the Afro Latin Jazz Alliance which is now called Belongo. In fact we’re about to…

We’ve actually got 47 teaching artists in 21 New York City school districts, we have a pre-professional training program, we’ve I mean we’ve created a whole international touring performing presence with award-winning music by incredible orchestras. All of that really is in the service of humanity, and the service of creating community. So for me the biggest joy in my life is not having recognition but using music as a way to bring human beings together to live meaningful, productive lives with dignity and grace.…
